items.name: Mead (Mug)
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price  2 gp (gallon),  5 cp (mug); Weight 8 lbs. (gallon), 1/2 lb. (mug)
DescriptionThis alcoholic beverage is made by fermenting honey and water. It may be flavored with spices, fruit, or hops.

items.name: Bullseye Rum
items.description:
“It hits you right in the center, just not in a good way.”
Bullseye Rum is the drink of choice for the truly desperate, the miserly, or those who simply value quantity over quality. Its dark amber hue suggests a richness it absolutely does not deliver. The label, featuring a dartboard and the motto "Bullseye," is both an ironic jab at the drink's questionable aftereffects and a promise of its unerring ability to ruin your stomach. items.description:

  Casting Time 1 Standard

  Components V, S

  

  
  Range Personal

  
  Targets creature touched

  
  Duration Instantaneous

  

This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level

items.name: Blood Caimon Hide
items.description:
Caimon Hide Armor is Buoyant and it bestows no armor check penalty on Swim checks attempted by the wearer. 
It's smooth texture allows for smooth movement through water, granting a small swim-skill bonus.  
It is slightly lighter than conventional hide armor, and allows for greater dexterity. 
All other armor check penalties apply as normal.

items.name: Street Meat
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 1 cp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionUsually sold by vendors on a thin wooden stick, these small chunks of cooked meat often come from many different sorts of creatures-rats and pigeons are the most common.

items.name: Firegrass Angler
items.description:
Level 3 Magic Fishing Pole – “The Firegrass Angler” (Wondrous Item, 2,000 gp)Aura faint transmutation
Slot —
CL 3rd
Weight 5 lbs
DescriptionThis masterfully crafted fishing rod is carved from driftwood, reinforced with tukkar sinew, and tipped with an obsidian hook said to be from the depths of the volcanic trenches surrounding Firegrass Island. It hums with primal ocean magic, granting the wielder an uncanny ability to lure and reel in fish of all sizes—including sea monsters.
Abilities:
Master

items.name: Rope (Silk, 50 Ft.)
items.description:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 10 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis rope has 4 hit points and can be burst with a DC 24 Strength check.

items.name: Mulled Wine
items.description: Mulled wine becomes a staple drink as the colder seasons begin. The wine is boiled and then infused with sugar, black pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and orange peels. Served hot, it is rumored to cure the common cold, though it is primarily enjoyed for its warming effect.

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
items.description: This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.description:
Source PZO1110

You can throw a flask of alchemist's fire as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet.

A direct hit deals 1d6 points of fire damage. Every creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hits takes 1 point of fire damage from the splash. On the round following a direct hit, the target takes an additional 1d6 points of damage. If desired, the target can use a full-round action to attempt to extinguish the flames before taking this additional damage. Extinguishing the

items.name: Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag
items.description:
Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag (Level 3 Wondrous Item)Price: 1,500 gp
Aura faint transmutation
Slot —
CL 3rd
Weight 10 lbs
DescriptionThe Tukkaroo Sleeping Bag is a thick, yak-like fur bedroll, crafted from naturally shed tukkar wool and lined with woven seaweed fibers from the shores of Firegrass Island. Enchanted with druidic magic, this bedroll provides unparalleled warmth, resilience, and rejuvenation to those who rest within it.

items.name: Broadcloth
items.description: The most common type of cloth, it is usually referred to as plain cloth. Traditionally used in any form of clothing, as well, as for interior decoration, such as tablecloths, curtains, and wall covers.

items.name: Isle 418 Wildflower Petals
items.description: Dried wildflower petals from Isle 418 in Southern Shackles. Said to have hallucinogenic properties.

items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus; Cost 500 gp

items.name: Numerian Vibrox
items.description:
Said to be made with an ancient, possibly alien technology in Numeria, these blades are non-magical and yet unbelievably sharp and resilient.
They strike as adamantine for purposes of bypassing Damage Reduction.

items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.name: Mulled Wine
items.description: Mulled wine becomes a staple drink as the colder seasons begin. The wine is boiled and then infused with sugar, black pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and orange peels. Served hot, it is rumored to cure the common cold, though it is primarily enjoyed for its warming effect.

items.name: Assassin Vines
items.description: It is sometimes also named Sparrow Grass, its young shoots are often used as a spring vegetable. They are usually served as an appetizer or a vegetable side dish. In some regions, there is word of a festival held in its honor.

items.name: Devil's Lantern
items.description: This black iron lantern has a pit fiend's head logo on the side and casts that horned shadow wherever it shines. It requires no oil and produces light as a normal lantern whenever it is opened. Once per day, it can cause an invisibility purge effect for a few rounds.

items.name: Necklace of 7 Coins
items.description: Kofusachi's religious symbol is a string of seven coins.

items.name: Yogurt
items.description:
YogurtSource Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price  1 sp; Weight  1/2 lb.
Category Food/DrinkDescriptionThis thick, fermented milk has a tangier taste than unprocessed milk. It may be sweetened with fruit, honey, or jam; blended with chopped herbs and oil to create a sauce; or mixed with water and salt, sugar, fruit, or mint as a drink.

items.name: Chain Shirt MW
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

items.name: Rolling Sea
items.description:
These steel-knuckles are etched with swirling storm clouds and lightning bolts. When worn, they hum faintly with the sound of distant thunder, as though they are perpetually on the edge of a brewing storm.
They are +1 magic, and deliver an additional 1d6 sonic damage. Their base damage is 1d4, or the wearer's unarmed damage value if they are a monk or brawler. 
A limited number of times per day, the wearer can deliver an aoe sonic attack by punching the ground with both fists.

items.name: Meat of Blood Caiman
items.description: Meat of an Ustalavian Blood Caiman.

items.name: Loa's Dream Sap
items.description: Lo’a’s Dream Sap – A thick, golden sap from an ancient jungle tree that only grows near Lo’a’s nesting grounds. If mixed into a potion, it doubles its duration or potency, but the drinker must make a Wisdom save (DC 14) or fall into a deep, primal sleep filled with visions of prehistoric beasts.

items.name: Blood Caimon Tacos
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Savage Sustenance
items.description:
A cookbook for carnivorous barbarians. This item grants +5 circumstance bonus on cooking checks when used to "take 10" or the book is consulted for at least 10 minutes. It also contains a number of famous recipes from all over Ustalav, each slightly improved by the author.
Conquer your hunger with a symphony of carnivorous decadence, forging legends through each ravenous bite, and embracing the primal ecstasy that only the flesh of the slain can provide.
Savage Sustenance
